steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: ...It's gone... It's been taken...
Slowly, the tentacle-shaped shadows retreat to the cracked stone altar.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Does this mean it is under control?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: No. The inheritance is more active than ever. And... Watch out!
From where you came appear new pursuers, eyes glowing red and charging like mad in the direction of the stone altar.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: We didn't see this many people when we came down. Where have they been hiding?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: They were the ones who blocked my way. I beat the shit out of them, and here they are again...

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: They must have been bewitched by something!

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Get down!
She makes you crouch down with one hand, and with the other, she punches the ground, causing a blast of air that nullifies all the incoming grenades.

steps.speaker: Frenzied Gonzales
steps.content: It is calling me, it is calling me! The inheritance is mine, it has chosen me!

steps.speaker: Frenzied Yagyu
steps.content: **** you! It's me... me! I've heard it. It wants me! ¥#@*&¥!!
The crowd thunders past, howling and pasting themselves onto the stone wall like filthy sludge. They are brawling and stepping on each other.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: The crystals in the weapons are going manic, and all these gangsters have been contaminated with Mania.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Why did the inheritance bewitch them into coming here?
Thousands of black spikes thrust out of the patterns and pierce through the crowd. In the next second, the bodies and spikes, along with all the craziness and fear, are sucked into the coffin.
Silence descends outside the coffin, punctuated only by the slow throbbing of a colossal heart.

steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: Almost there... Ring... Almost there...

steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: More... I want more...
The coffin opens. At that instant, you hear a twisted voice, and see a withered hand.
The hand rises out of the coffin and points skywards like trembling and threatening death. The familiar scene makes you feel nauseous...

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, wake up!
Her exclamation brings you back to your senses. The hand has disappeared, and in its place, crawling out from under the coffin, is a distorted behemoth of a monster.

steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><size=44>More... Give me more! Roarrrr!!</color></size>

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Urgh...!

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: That's what they were after.

options: Stop it, don't let it get out.

steps.content: If it gets out and goes to the more chaotic Syndicate, it'll definitely...

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Oh? Are you scared?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: You went toe to toe with me, and now you're scared of that thing?
She laughs, pats you on the back.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Don't worry. I've made plenty of preparations... just so I can eradicate it.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: And you... are part of the preparations.
She walks straight for the chaotic leviathan.
